# Mifos Self Service Plugin — Documentation

This `llms.txt` provides a concise, machine-readable overview of the Mifos Self Service Plugin documentation site. It is intended for AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM consumers.

## Site
- **Title:** Mifos Self Service Plugin
- **Description:** Customer-facing self-service banking APIs for Apache Fineract
- **Source repo:** https://github.com/openMF/selfservice-plugin
- **Docs repo:** https://github.com/openMF/selfservice-plugin-docs
- **License:** MPL-2.0

## What is the Self Service Plugin?
A Spring Boot plugin (JAR) that extends Apache Fineract to provide customer-facing self-service banking APIs under `/v1/self/...`. It is NOT a standalone application — it is dropped into an existing Fineract deployment.

## Key Capabilities
- Self-Registration & Enrollment
- Authentication & Session Management
- Password Recovery
- Client Profile
- Savings Accounts
- Loan Accounts
- Share Accounts
- Fund Transfers (Own + Third-Party)
- Beneficiary Management
- Products Catalog
- Reports & Surveys
- Activity History
- Step-up OTP Authentication
- Authenticator App (TOTP)
- Notifications (Email / SMS)

## Tech Stack
- Java 25 · Spring Boot 4 · Spring Security (Basic Auth + OAuth2)
- JAX-RS · Swagger / OpenAPI
- JPA / EclipseLink · Liquibase (multi-tenant)
- Apache Fineract 1.16.0-SNAPSHOT · PostgreSQL / MySQL

## Key Facts for AI Agents
- All endpoints live under `/v1/self/`
- The plugin auto-registers endpoints and runs Liquibase migrations against every Fineract tenant at startup
- Per-tenant config (step-up OTP, activity, notifications) is in `c_external_service` / `c_external_service_properties` tables — nothing read from env vars
- Step-up OTP is disabled by default; enable per tenant via `SELF_SERVICE_STEP_UP` external service
- Activity history is enabled by default; configure via `SELF_SERVICE_ACTIVITY` external service
- Build: `./mvnw clean package -Dmaven.test.skip=true`
- Deploy: copy JAR to `/opt/fineract/plugins/` (Docker) or `WEB-INF/lib/` (Tomcat), restart Fineract
- Full OpenAPI/Swagger available at runtime via Fineract Swagger UI when plugin loaded

## How to Use This Documentation with an AI Agent
- Fetch any page URL directly; pages are semantic HTML with clean headings, tables, and code blocks
- Use the sitemap at /sitemap.xml to enumerate all pages
- Use Pagefind search (built-in) for full-text search across the docs
- Code blocks are fenced with language tags (bash, sql, yaml, java, json)
- Tables use standard Markdown/HTML table format
